{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Check if the groups (email vs paid_search) are comparable in terms of customer_segment and customer_age
# Cross-tabulate channel with customer_segment
customer_segment_ct = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(customer_segment_ct)
print("\n")

# Cross-tabulate channel with customer_age (group into bins)
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])
age_group_ct = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['age_group'])
print("Age group distribution by channel:")
print(age_group_ct)

# Clean up
del df['age_group']"}
